title: Vacuum actuator with integrated pressure sensor

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: This reference describes an integrated pressure transducer-vacuum actuator unit for internal combustion engines, not a cordless handheld vacuum lifting device.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph 13) The reference mentions a sealing element (O-ring) that seals a chamber, but it is not a flexible sealing lip on a suction cup bounding a sealed region against a workpiece. It seals an internal chamber of the device.
features.quote_src: Der Dichtungsabschnitt 40 bzw. das als O-Ring ausgestaltete Dichtelement 38 wirken mit einer Begrenzungswand einer ersten Kammer 64 des Unterdruckstellers 12 zusammen.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.quote: Die integrierte Druckwandler-Unterdruck-Stelleinheit 14 umfasst einen Druckwandler 10, welcher bevorzugt als elektropneumatischer Wandler ausgestaltet ist, sowie einen Unterdrucksteller 12.
features.note: The reference describes an electropneumatic transducer and a vacuum actuator, which are part of a system to control vacuum levels, but not an electric vacuum pump to draw air from a sealed region against a workpiece.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a pressure transducer (Druckwandler) that can connect to vacuum and atmospheric pressure levels, implying it can sense pressure, but it does not explicitly state it monitors the vacuum level in a sealed region for lifting.
features.quote_src: Integrierte Druckwandler-Unterdruck-Stelleinheit (14) mit einem Druckwandler (10) mit einer Kammer (68), die mit einem Unterdruckniveau p<vac> und dem Atmosphärendruckniveau p<ATM> verbindbar ist

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: The reference describes a position feedback system for an actuator, not a warning indicator for a vacuum level falling below a threshold for a lifting device.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference does not discuss any warning thresholds or load-release vacuum levels.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators or their behavior related to vacuum levels.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference does not mention a rechargeable battery or any power source for the device.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators or their placement for visibility during a lifting operation.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: The reference describes an integrated unit for engine control, not a single-hand portable lifting device without external hoses or cords.

overall.why: This reference describes an integrated pressure transducer and vacuum actuator unit for internal combustion engines, which is a different application and device type than a cordless handheld vacuum lifting device.
